report.title: AFLA germline report
report.description: Interactive report: QC, coverage, variants with ACMG/AMP evidence suggestions, HPO gene ranking, family inheritance, CNV, SV, ROH and a printable case report.

fastp-report.title: Read QC report (fastp)
fastp-report.description: Read quality before and after trimming.

coverage.title: Coverage summary
coverage.description: mosdepth depth summary over target regions.

variants.title: Variants (normalised, quality-labelled)
variants.description: Small variants within target regions; failing calls labelled LowQual. For families the file is named after the family.

annotated-variants.title: Annotated variants
annotated-variants.description: Variants with Ensembl VEP annotation (CSQ field).

roh.title: Runs of homozygosity
roh.description: bcftools roh regions (RG lines: sample, chromosome, start, end, length).

cnv.title: Copy-number segments (CNVkit)
cnv.description: Segments with log2 ratio and copy number; plot in {{ alias }}.cnv_scatter.png.
